issue: `Inventory.remove()` lets stock go negative. Removing more than is in stock must raise ValueError and change nothing; removing exactly the remaining quantity deletes the item, so it no longer appears in `items()`. Quantities must be positive integers for add() and remove().
prompt_template:
Bug report for the project in {workdir}:

`Inventory.remove()` lets stock go negative. Removing more than is in stock must raise ValueError and change nothing; removing exactly the remaining quantity deletes the item, so it no longer appears in `items()`. Quantities must be positive integers for add() and remove().

Fix the bug in the source code (not the tests). Run the tests with `pytest -q`. When you're done, reply with a short summary of what you changed and whether the tests pass.
